Overview.Name: Javvaji Jagadish Reddy
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & boiled egg (1)
Option 3: Paneer bhurji (60 g) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & grilled chicken (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & spinach curry
Option 3: Home style chicken biryani (moderate portion) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since diabetes is present, keep rice portions smaller and make eggs or chicken the main part of meals.
Late night eating can increase sugar fluctuations, so keep dinner lighter and earlier when possible.
Because biryani is a favorite, include it in controlled home style portions instead of avoiding it completely.
Choose pan fried or grilled foods instead of deep fried snacks to manage cravings.
Simple cooking and regular meal timing will help improve energy and blood sugar balance.
